technicalValidation.limitations: These prior geometry/clearance findings carry to43 because all geometry and all transforms exactly match42. No new moving state has been claimed.

recommendationScope: Retain as improved unqualified diagnostic candidate; corrections required before whole-asset production review or qualification.

coreObjections.strongestReasonBelowProductionReady: Long gun, seven road wheels, angular turret, bustle rack and asymmetric roof stations read as an Abrams-family vehicle. However M1A1-specific recognition across every required 256px view has not been evidenced. Simplified sight, cupola and secondary guns carry less identifying construction than the MCO common-exterior drawings.

The broad primary contour is legible, but the forward skirt ends are square slabs, the track assembly is mostly a smooth continuous band with sparse bars, and gun/roof fittings simplify important contour breaks. Whole-form proportion and silhouette correspondence remain unqualified against an authoritative coherent dimensional target.

Audited new mounts are supported, driver/turret/main-gun and new deck clearances pass for the specified range. Nevertheless the retained roof/shoulder junction steps have not been reconciled; wheel hubs, drive/idler hardware, skirt fasteners and weapon supports remain schematic. Static fit is not proof of hatch, secondary-gun, recoil or track articulation.

Current hash-verified export and independent recipe checks pass, including repair of the r41 transform failure. Complete whole-asset qualification still lacks resolved dimensional authority and a named production contract; exact current isolation/mask receipts are being collected separately and are not certified by this review. Native validation demonstrably missed the r41 displaced wheels.

styleAssessment.reason: No immutable style profile is bound.

coreObjections.objection: No bound immutable profile defines the permitted detail bandwidth. The result combines a refined turret outline with broad blank hull and simple wheel discs; consistency cannot be established.
No bound shape grammar. Angular chassis slabs, faceted gun forms and planar fitting blocks vary in refinement; known roof interface steps remain unresolved.
Rear ribs now read, but similar tan values merge gun, glacis and turret planes in the front and three-quarter views. Whether this meets intended gameplay contrast is unestablished.

All six neutral views are complete and unclipped. There is no immutable style presentation binding, and render metadata lightingIntent still describes no finish/12.5m although current material finish and projection correspond to11.5m. Camera arrays and pixels, not stale prose, were used for review.

otherCategories.observation: Silhouette is credible as an Abrams-family blockout; no new macro mass changes in pass2/3. Existing dimension/registration uncertainty prevents claiming exact internal proportion fidelity.

Stations, sight, smoke launchers, skirt segmentation and deck/roof panels improve functional hierarchy. Large front glacis remains blank; side hubs are painted discs rather than fully described running gear.
Tan paint, dark rubber/steel and sparse blue glass separate major materials. Rear backing/frame/ribs now read distinctly. FLAT rendering cannot establish roughness or richer surface response.

All six reviewed frames are unclipped and current. Front and three-quarter expose the most simplification; the rear is materially improved. No conspicuous new floating fitting or displaced wheel remains.

prioritizedCorrections.acceptance: Bind a coherent M1A1 common-exterior target and intended stylization; reconcile conflicting height/clearance measurements and check hull/turret/gun/wheel relationships in side, plan and front. Existing envelope checks do not establish these relationships.

Measure and close the known11–13mm junction steps with an owned shell/interface revision that preserves accepted contour relationships; inspect above/underside and yaw/elevation states. Do not cover the discrepancy with an unexplained strip.

prioritizedCorrections.scope: Finish functional construction within a revised resource plan
prioritizedCorrections.acceptance: Use the references to resolve front skirt shape, wheel/drive details, track construction and sight/secondary-gun supports. Preserve the existing component ownership and ground/motion clearances; current reserve is356triangles and no object slots.

Bind an immutable style profile, complete current isolation/masks and declared motion evidence, produce all-view256px recognition comparisons against nearest neighbors, then submit a complete hash-bound deterministic rubric assessment before any visual-go claim.

scorePolicy: No scores manufactured. This independent adversarial report is not the primary structured rubric assessment or a deterministic evaluator result.
